title: Personal
body: Your inventory, tasks and subscriptions, hosted by your Hub.
signInBody: Sign in to choose the account that owns your personal data.
pairHint: Enter this code in Personal settings on the selected device within ten minutes. It can be used once.
noDevices: Register a device with this Hub to link your personal account.
emptyConversations: Start a conversation on a linked device to use your enabled personal tools.
failure: Could not complete this action. Your input has been kept. Check the connection and try again.
emptyChat: Ask about your personal tools. Your linked device runs the agent.
unavailable: The device is unavailable. Reconnect it and refresh to continue.
